title: Flavv's Sticky Chili Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thighs or drumsticks, salt and black pepper
Sauce: 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp brown sugar
Aromatics & Heat: 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 tbsp chili sauce
Oils: 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cooking oil
Garnish: Fresh green and red chilies, cilantro, lime slices
steps: Pat chicken dry and season lightly with salt and black pepper.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, chili sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Heat cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear chicken until golden on both sides.
Pour sauce into skillet, reduce heat to medium, and simmer while turning chicken occasionally.
Spoon caramelized sauce over chicken until thick, glossy, and fully cooked.
Garnish with sliced chilies, cilantro, and lime slices, then serve hot.
